item.summary: A 24-year-old British man has been sentenced to six years in prison in the United States after pleading guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and aggravated identity theft, as part of the group Scattered Spider, Realtid reported on 19 November 2026. According to Realtid, the group used SMS phishing and SIM swapping, and cryptocurrency worth about SEK 120 million was stolen; the paper, referring to the US Department of Justice, says at least twelve companies were affected. Realtid writes that he was arrested in Spain in May 2024 and extradited in April 2025, and that he is the fifth person sentenced in the US case. The official Justice Department text was not read for this report.
